lakeside.name: Lakeside
lakeside.card: Water events give 1.5x water (rounded up to 0.5 L). Unprotected dehydration events make you lose 1 HP less.

glacier_ridge.name: Glacier Ridge
glacier_ridge.card: Unprotected cold-weather events (including hypothermia) and slip or fall events make you lose 1 HP more. Water events give no water without a stove to melt ice.

deep_forest.name: Deep Forest
deep_forest.card: Food and berry events give 100 kcal more. Unprotected humid or wet-cold events and insect events make you lose 1 HP more.

valley_floor.name: Valley Floor
valley_floor.card: Unprotected rain and wind events make you lose 1 HP less. Unprotected navigation events make you lose 1 HP more (the open valley has few landmarks). Water events give 1.2x water.

high_plateau.name: High Plateau
high_plateau.card: Unprotected sun, heat and wind events make you lose 1 HP more. Unprotected navigation events make you lose 1 HP less.

scree_slope.name: Scree Slope
scree_slope.card: Unprotected slip, fall and sprain events make you lose 1 HP more. Unprotected equipment events that already cost HP make you lose 1 HP more.

cave_mouth.name: Cave Mouth
cave_mouth.card: Unprotected cold-night events make you lose 1 HP less. Unprotected food-spoilage events make you lose 1 HP more. Without a headlamp, night-navigation events make you lose 1 HP more.

wind_pass.name: Wind Pass
wind_pass.card: Unprotected wind events make you lose 2 HP more. Unprotected rain and snow storms make you lose 1 HP more.

boggy_hollow.name: Boggy Hollow
boggy_hollow.card: Water is easy to find but always dirty: without purification tablets, a filter or a stove, water events make you lose 1 HP more. Unprotected insect events make you lose 1 HP more.

old_trail.name: Old Trail
old_trail.card: Unprotected navigation events make you lose 2 HP less. Calm wildlife encounters never change your HP.
